commands.remnant_mobs.inspect.none: No monster in sight (look at one within 32 blocks)

config.remnant_mobs.client.hud.hunters_m: A moon icon in the bottom right while a Hunter's Moon is up.
config.remnant_mobs.client.hud.lens.tool: The Lens threat readout and its scope stat sheet.
config.remnant_mobs.client.nameplates.di: How far away ranked mobs and bosses show their plate (also any mob you look at).
config.remnant_mobs.client.nameplates.hi: Hide plates when the HUD is hidden (F1), like vanilla name tags.
config.remnant_mobs.client.nameplates.le: relative colours a level against your own (RPG Attribute System, or experience levels if the server uses them); absolute keeps it neutral.
config.remnant_mobs.client.nameplates.lo: Only the mob you look at
Show only the plate of the mob under your crosshair.
config.remnant_mobs.client.nameplates.re: Named mobs show their name on the plate instead of a separate name tag.
config.remnant_mobs.client.nameplates.sc: Scale of the plates (1 is normal).
config.remnant_mobs.client.nameplates.tr: How close you must be to read traits (always shown on the mob you look at).
config.remnant_mobs.denied: Only operators can change server settings
config.remnant_mobs.difficulty.compat.di: When a mod in overlap_mod_ids is installed, Remnants rolls no traits so the two do not stack. Levels, ranks and events stay.
config.remnant_mobs.difficulty.compat.ov: Mod ids that give monsters elite affixes.
config.remnant_mobs.difficulty.dimension: Overrides keys of a factor in this dimension only, e.g. {"distance": {"per": 64}}; the rest comes from factors. (start_y cannot be overridden per dimension.)
(band min + factors) x multiplier. It multiplies the band minimum too: the Nether starts at 17 instead of 15, the End at 43 instead of 35. Unlisted dimensions use 1.
Levels added after the multiplier (negative to subtract).
config.remnant_mobs.difficulty.enabled.t: Master switch. When false, levels follow levels.json exactly as in 3.0.
config.remnant_mobs.difficulty.exclude_d: These keep the levels.json formula. The shipped tag is empty.
config.remnant_mobs.difficulty.factors.<: With t = input / per: linear is t, sqrt is √t (fast start, slow later), log is ln(1 + t) (slower still), power is t^exponent (slow start, fast later with exponent above 1).
When false the factor adds nothing. Factors: days, played, distance, depth, gear.
Most levels the factor can add.
The input that makes t = 1: days, hours, blocks or gear points per level on a linear curve.
config.remnant_mobs.difficulty.factors.d: Depth counts blocks below this height, in dimensions with a sky.
config.remnant_mobs.difficulty.gear_scor: Gear score points per armor point.
Points per attack damage above the bare-hand 1.
Points per max health above 20 (Vital Embers and modded health count).
config.remnant_mobs.difficulty.rank_odds: How the multiplier rises across the band. sqrt gives x1.5 at 25% on the meter and x1.71 at 50%. log never reaches the full multiplier (x1.69 at 100% with the default 2); power acts like linear here.
Rank chances are multiplied by up to this as the threat rises from the bottom (x1) to the top (x this) of the band.
config.remnant_mobs.elites.aura.distance: Players within this many blocks see it.
Particles in the rank's colour around ranked monsters; Champions and Remnants get a turning ring.
config.remnant_mobs.elites.aura.min_rank: Lowest rank with an aura. common or an unknown value counts as elite.
config.remnant_mobs.elites.boss_bars.cha: Champions get a boss bar like Remnants.
Colour of a Champion's boss bar.
config.remnant_mobs.elites.boss_bars.rem: Colour of a Remnant's boss bar.
config.remnant_mobs.elites.champion_titl: Champions get a generated title too, not only Remnants.
config.remnant_mobs.elites.enabled.toolt: Master switch. When false, Remnant boss bars stay yellow and nothing below applies.
config.remnant_mobs.elites.event_glow.to: Monsters sent by an event night glow (seen through walls) until dawn.
config.remnant_mobs.events.enabled.toolt: Master switch for the scheduled events (not the Hunter's Moon). One event runs at a time and never during a Hunter's Moon. /remnants event start <id> runs one anyway.
config.remnant_mobs.events.events.<event: A title on screen at dusk.
Where it runs: players elsewhere are not hunted and get no bonus levels. An empty list means nowhere.
Levels added to the threat while it runs (in its dimensions; the "+N" on the meter).
Rank chances of mobs spawning in its dimensions while it runs are multiplied by this.
Remnant Shards dropped by its hunters and mini-boss are multiplied by this.
Nearest blocks from the player a hunter spawns.
Seconds after dusk before the first wave. Waves wait while nobody is online to hunt.
Most hunters alive per player; a wave sends fewer when this is reached.
Hunters roll a rank as usual but are at least this rank.
Hunters sent after each player per wave.
A mini-boss (#remnant_mobs:event_mini_bosses) joins the last wave.
Levels above the threat where it spawns (on top of effects.level_bonus), within the band.
One per hunted player instead of one for a random player.
Which boss-tier spawner makes it. Unknown tiers use mini.
Extra Remnant Shards the mini-boss drops.
Experience points for every hunted player alive at dawn.
Valor for the same players, with RPG Attribute System.
Chance it starts on an eligible night (rolled at dusk).
It may roll every this many nights, counting from first_day.
The first in-game day it may roll on.
Only when at least one player stands at this fraction of their band or more (0.25 = 25% on the meter).
Only on full-moon or new-moon nights. Anything else counts as any.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.affect_passiv: Also level passive and neutral creatures (animals, villagers...). They never get ranks or traits.
The attribute a rule raises. max_health, minecraft:max_health and minecraft:generic.max_health all work; modded attributes too. Unknown ids are skipped.
The most the rule can add (a value for additive, a percentage otherwise). The sign is ignored.
additive: +per_level per level. percent: +per_level% of the mob's base value per level. multiplicative: compounds per_level% per level. A missing or unknown mode counts as percent.
How much one level adds (a value for additive, a percentage otherwise). Negative values lower the attribute.
Multiplies the distance part of the threat in unlisted dimensions (above 1 faster, below 1 slower).
Highest level in dimensions not listed under dimensions.
Lowest level in dimensions not listed under dimensions.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.depth.blocks_: Engine off: one level per this many blocks below start_y. Engine on: only the starting value of factors.depth.per.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.depth.max_lev: Engine off: cap on levels from depth. Engine on: only the starting value of factors.depth.max.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.depth.start_y: Depth levels count blocks below this height (dimensions with a sky only). Engine on: only the starting value of factors.depth.start_y.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.dimensions.<d: Multiplies distance levels in this dimension (engine off) or the distance fed into factors.distance (engine on).
The top of the band: the level cap for the dimension, and 100% on the meter.
The bottom of the dimension's band: every mob there is at least this level, and the threat starts here. A key left out of an entry falls back to default_band.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.distance.bloc: Engine off: one level per this many blocks from world spawn, horizontally, counted in Overworld blocks (a Nether block is 8). Engine on: only the starting value of difficulty.json → factors.distance.per.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.enabled.toolt: Master switch. When false, newly spawned mobs get no level, rank or traits (mobs already leveled keep theirs; event night hunters are still leveled).
Chance, rolled once per full-moon night, that a Hunter's Moon rises. It lasts until dawn, in dimensions with a day cycle.
Whether a Hunter's Moon can rise. Switching it off also ends one that is up.
Levels added to the threat while it is up (also the "+N" on the meter).
Rank chances of mobs spawning under it are multiplied by this.
Remnant Shards dropped by mobs that spawned under it (or die under it) are multiplied by this.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.mobs.boss_sta: Bosses (#remnant_mobs:bosses: Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian, #c:bosses, Remnant Bosses) show a level on their plate; set true to also scale their stats and experience.
Mobs that never get a level (and so no rank or traits). The #remnant_mobs:never_leveled tag does the same.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.mobs.level_lo: Fixed levels per mob type, e.g. {"minecraft:warden": 40}. Ignores threat, spread and band; the rank still rolls.
Which nearby player(s) count, for the level pull and for the engine's played and gear factors. Anything else counts as average.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.players.radiu: Players within this many blocks of the spawn point count (also for played and gear).
config.remnant_mobs.levels.players.sourc: What counts as a player's level: RPG Attribute System level (without RAS installed, players are ignored), vanilla experience level, or nothing. Also the level nameplate colours compare against.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.players.weigh: How far the threat moves toward the nearby players' level: 0 ignores players, 1 makes mobs match them, 0.35 moves it about a third of the way. Works up and down.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.scale_project: Arrows, tridents, fireballs and other damage that does not come from the mob's own attack damage scale like attack damage (level, rank and Berserk).
config.remnant_mobs.levels.spread.toolti: Each mob's level is the threat plus a random whole number from -spread to +spread, kept inside the band. 0 makes every mob in a spot the same level.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.structures.<s: Mobs spawning inside this structure (any structure id, modded too) get at least this threat. Applied before the player pull, so nearby low-level players can still pull it down.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.time.days_per: Engine off: one level per this many in-game days. Engine on: only the starting value of factors.days.per.
config.remnant_mobs.levels.time.max_leve: Engine off: cap on levels from days. Engine on: only the starting value of factors.days.max.
Players within this many blocks see it.
config.remnant_mobs.loot.beams.enabled.t: A column of light over rare items a ranked monster drops.
config.remnant_mobs.loot.beams.min_rarit: Lowest item rarity with a beam. An unknown value counts as rare.
config.remnant_mobs.loot.beams.seconds.t: Seconds a beam lasts (it ends early when the item is picked up).
config.remnant_mobs.loot.loot_bags.chanc: Chance per rank; event_boss is an event night's mini-boss.
config.remnant_mobs.loot.loot_bags.enabl: With Mob LootBags installed, ranked monsters killed by a player may drop a bag on top of that mod's own drops.
config.remnant_mobs.loot.loot_bags.items: Dropped by id when Mob LootBags' own bag code cannot be reached.
config.remnant_mobs.loot.loot_bags.mod_i: The mod id that tells Remnants Mob LootBags is installed.
An unknown tier uses the default.
config.remnant_mobs.loot.loot_bags.tier_: From this difficulty the bag is one tier better (never past mythic).
config.remnant_mobs.loot.scaling.common_: Chance, times difficulty, that an unranked monster rolls its loot once more.
config.remnant_mobs.loot.scaling.extra_r: Ranked monsters roll their loot table loot_rolls x (1 + this x difficulty) extra times; a fraction is the chance of one more roll. 1 doubles the rolls at the top of the band.
config.remnant_mobs.loot.scaling.shards_: The same for Remnant Shards (+50% at the top).
config.remnant_mobs.progression.drops.di: Every chance above is multiplied by 1 + this x difficulty (difficulty 0 to 1: the mob's level across its band), so 1 doubles them at the top of the band.
config.remnant_mobs.progression.drops.hu: Chance per player kill of an Elite or higher.
config.remnant_mobs.progression.drops.me: Chance per player kill of a Veteran or higher.
config.remnant_mobs.progression.drops.vi: Chance per player kill of a ranked monster (Common monsters never drop it).
Chance for an event night's mini-boss.
Master switch: when false, ranked monsters drop none of the items below and the meter is not sent. Items players already have keep working.
Seconds before the next one can be drunk.
Fraction of max health healed at once.
Seconds of Regeneration I after drinking.
Seconds before the next one can be used.
config.remnant_mobs.progression.hearts.h: Hearts of max health one Vital Ember adds.
config.remnant_mobs.progression.hearts.m: Vital Embers stop working at this many extra hearts.
config.remnant_mobs.progression.meter.an: The screen corner it sits in.
config.remnant_mobs.progression.meter.hu: Draw the difficulty meter on your screen. False hides it for you only.
config.remnant_mobs.progression.meter.se: The server sends each player their difficulty once a second. False hides the meter for everyone.
GUI pixels from that corner's side.
GUI pixels from that corner's top or bottom (26 keeps it above the Hunter's Moon icon).
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.enabled.toolti: When false, every leveled mob is Common: no ranks, no traits.
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.level_chance_d: Rank chances are multiplied by 1 + level / this: x1.6 at level 30 by default. Lower means ranks get common faster with level.
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.ranks.<rank>.c: Chance before multipliers. Ranks are checked from Remnant down to Veteran and the first that rolls wins.
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.ranks.<rank>.d: Multiplies the leveled attack damage (and ranged damage with scale_projectile_damage).
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.ranks.<rank>.e: Multiplies dropped experience (after the level bonus in rewards.json).
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.ranks.<rank>.l: Rolls of the mob's loot table on top of the normal drop (rewards.json → loot.extra_rolls).
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.ranks.<rank>.m: The rank never rolls on a mob below this level.
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.ranks.<rank>.s: Fewest Remnant Shards it drops (rewards.json → loot.shards).
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.ranks.<rank>.t: How many traits it rolls (fewer if not enough traits are allowed).
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.remnant.announ: A server-wide message when a Remnant falls, naming who slew it.
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.remnant.boss_b: A boss bar for players within 32 blocks who can see the Remnant.
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.remnant.horn_r: Players within this many blocks hear a horn and see a message when a Remnant spawns.
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.remnant.titles: Remnant-rank mobs get a generated title ("Vorgrim the Hollow") unless they already have a name.
config.remnant_mobs.ranks.spawner_multip: Rank chances of mobs from monster spawners are multiplied by this.
config.remnant_mobs.reset.none: No default: this entry was added to the file
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.branded_mult: Mobs marked with a Brand of Challenge multiply experience, extra loot, shards and Valor by this.
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.experience.p: Dropped experience is multiplied by 1 + level x this, then by the rank's experience. Bosses keep vanilla experience unless mobs.boss_stats is on.
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.loot.extra_r: Ranked mobs roll their loot table again (ranks.json → loot_rolls; loot.json adds more).
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.loot.require: Extra loot and shards only when a player took part in the kill (keeps mob farms in check). Vital Embers, healing items and loot bags always need a player kill.
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.shards.exper: Experience points per Remnant Shard absorbed, without RAS.
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.shards.valor: Valor per Remnant Shard absorbed, with RAS.
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.valor.challe: The bonus multiplier for a mob well above your RAS level.
Levels above you where max is reached (linear up to it).
The multiplier for a mob well below your RAS level.
Levels below you where min is reached.
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.valor.enable: With RPG Attribute System: bonus Valor for the player who kills a ranked mob, on top of RAS's own kill Valor. Does nothing without RAS.
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.valor.messag: Show the bonus above the hotbar.
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.valor.per_le: Added per mob level: bonus = (per_rank + level x per_level) x challenge.
config.remnant_mobs.rewards.valor.per_ra: Base bonus per rank. Only ranked mobs pay, so common has no effect.
config.remnant_mobs.side.client: Your own setting: only changes what you see
config.remnant_mobs.status.host: Editing this world's settings: you are the host
config.remnant_mobs.status.local: Editing this computer's files (used by single-player worlds)
config.remnant_mobs.status.operator: Editing the server's settings as an operator
config.remnant_mobs.status.read_only: Server settings are read-only: only operators can change them
config.remnant_mobs.status.unavailable: This server does not share its settings (it needs Remnants 3.2+)
config.remnant_mobs.title: Remnants: RPG Mobs settings
config.remnant_mobs.too_many: Too many changes at once: save fewer at a time
config.remnant_mobs.traits.<trait>.exclu: Mobs that never get this trait.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.<trait>.min_r: The lowest rank that can roll it. common or an unknown value counts as veteran.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.<trait>.weigh: Relative roll chance against the other allowed traits.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.berserk.below: Goes berserk below this fraction of its health.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.blinking.chan: Chance, when hit, to teleport behind its attacker.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.blinking.rang: It only teleports when the attacker is within twice this many blocks (16 by default).
config.remnant_mobs.traits.crushing.knoc: Extra knockback strength of its melee hits.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.crushing.shie: Seconds a blocked melee hit disables the shield.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.deflecting.re: Projectiles deal this much less damage to it (0.6 = 60% less).
config.remnant_mobs.traits.frostbite.fre: Ticks of powder-snow frost added per hit (the target is frozen from 140). Frostbite mobs never freeze.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.frostbite.slo: Seconds of Slowness on a hit.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.infernal.fire: Seconds a hit sets the target on fire. Infernal mobs are immune to fire.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.juggernaut.he: Extra max health (0.5 = +50%). Juggernauts also ignore knockback.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.packleader.he: Calls its pack once, when its health drops to this fraction.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.packleader.mi: Minions are this many levels lower (at least level 1).
How many copies it calls. Minions are Common and drop no extra loot, shards or Valor.
It counts as in combat for this long after it was hurt.
Fraction healed per second while in combat.
Fraction of max health healed per second out of combat.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.thornskin.ref: Fraction of melee damage it takes that hurts the attacker.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.vampiric.heal: Heals this fraction of the damage it deals.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.venomous.pois: Seconds of Poison on a hit (Poison I, Poison II from Champion).
config.remnant_mobs.traits.volatile.fuse: Seconds between death and the blast.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.volatile.powe: Explosion power after death (a creeper is 3). It never breaks blocks, and spares the mob's own drops.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.warded.regrow: The shield regrows this many seconds after it was last hurt.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.warded.shield: Absorption worth this fraction of its max health.
config.remnant_mobs.traits.withering.wit: Seconds of Wither I on a hit.
event.remnant_mobs.end: Dawn breaks. The hunt is over.
event.remnant_mobs.grim_vigil.chat: The Grim Vigil falls. Until dawn, named hunters track every survivor, and something worse follows them.
event.remnant_mobs.grim_vigil.subtitle: Something hunts you until dawn
event.remnant_mobs.grim_vigil.title: The Grim Vigil
event.remnant_mobs.hunters_moon.chat: A Hunter's Moon rises. Until dawn, monsters spawn stronger, ranks come more often and shards drop more.
event.remnant_mobs.hunters_moon.subtitle: Monsters grow stronger until dawn
event.remnant_mobs.hunters_moon.title: The Hunter's Moon
item.remnant_mobs.brand_of_challenge.too: Use on a leveled monster: one rank higher, five levels stronger, one more trait
item.remnant_mobs.hunters_draught.toolti: Drink to heal a large part of your health, then regenerate
item.remnant_mobs.hunters_lens.tooltip: Held: shows the threat level of the area
item.remnant_mobs.hunters_lens.tooltip.s: Look through it at a monster to read its level, rank, traits and stats
item.remnant_mobs.mending_salve.tooltip: Use to heal a little over a few seconds
item.remnant_mobs.remnant_shard.tooltip: Use to absorb: Valor with RPG Attribute System, experience without it
Sneak to absorb the whole stack
item.remnant_mobs.vital_ember.tooltip: Use to grow your heart: one more heart of max health, for good
message.remnant_mobs.brand.already: It already bears a Brand of Challenge
message.remnant_mobs.brand.max: A Remnant cannot rise any higher
message.remnant_mobs.brand.not_leveled: Only leveled monsters can be challenged
message.remnant_mobs.ember.full: Your heart can hold no more embers (%s extra hearts)
message.remnant_mobs.ember.used: Your heart burns brighter: %s extra hearts
trait.remnant_mobs.berserk.desc: Below half health it hits harder and moves faster.
trait.remnant_mobs.blinking.desc: When hit, may teleport behind its attacker.
trait.remnant_mobs.crushing.desc: Hits knock you far back and break through shields.
trait.remnant_mobs.deflecting.desc: Takes much less damage from projectiles.
trait.remnant_mobs.frostbite.desc: Hits slow and freeze you. Cannot be frozen.
trait.remnant_mobs.infernal.desc: Immune to fire. Hits set you ablaze.
trait.remnant_mobs.juggernaut.desc: Cannot be knocked back. More health and armor, but slower.
trait.remnant_mobs.packleader.desc: Once wounded, calls lesser copies of itself to its side.
trait.remnant_mobs.regenerating.desc: Steadily regains health, quickly out of combat.
trait.remnant_mobs.thornskin.desc: Melee attackers take part of their damage back.
trait.remnant_mobs.vampiric.desc: Heals for part of the damage it deals.
trait.remnant_mobs.venomous.desc: Hits poison you; Champions and Remnants poison harder.
trait.remnant_mobs.volatile.desc: Explodes shortly after it dies. Step away.
trait.remnant_mobs.warded.desc: A shield of absorption that regrows when it is left alone.
